basic_info.description: Sunset View in Potrero Hill. Experience California indoor-outdoor living in this beautifully remodeled two-bedroom, two-bath condo with garage parking. Thoughtfully updated with designer touches, this stylish home features an open living and dining area with a fireplace and stunning west-facing Sutro Tower hillside views off a large balcony. Remodeled chef's kitchen boasts painted cabinetry, granite countertops, a glass tile backsplash, and stainless steel appliances. Up three steps, both bedrooms offer brand-new carpet and sliding glass doors leading to a private rear patio. The primary suite includes an en-suite bath and ample closet space. With nearly 1,100 sq. ft. of living space, this home also includes two storage units, and one-car garage parking all within a well-maintained two-unit building. Potrero Hill is loved for its warm climate, creative energy, and friendly community. Within close proximity to Philz Coffee, Whole Foods, and top dining spots like Plow and Chez Maman, plus easy access to the SF Design Center and Chase Center. Conveniently located near 101/280 and CalTrain.
